name: Builder — Promote Prototype to Production
description: Stage 6: user says 'ship it'. Creates project structure, dispatches to PO. Replaces project-promotion skill orchestration.

nodes.command: cd ~/projects/${trigger.slug} && git init && git add -A && git commit -m 'promote: ${trigger.slug} prototype to production'

nodes.body_template:
Take this prototype to production.

Project: ${trigger.slug}
Board: ${trigger.slug}

Read:
- ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/.context/grill/ for locked decisions
- ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/.context/dossier.md for market context
- ~/projects/${trigger.slug}/prototype/ for the working demo

You own: design goals, epics, milestones, beads tickets, dependencies.
You control tech-lead for implementation and verifier for review.
You maintain STATUS.md.

Create spec, epics, milestones, beads tickets for production.
This is NOT the builder anymore — this is production.
